# CML Licensing Policy

Copyright © 2026 Sherrie Joseph.

CML uses a split-license model so that the reference implementation can be adopted broadly
while the language specification and technical documentation remain openly reusable with
attribution.

- `cli.js`
- `demo.js`
- executable examples and software-oriented configuration or data files

SPDX identifier: `Apache-2.0`
